  "filename": "models.py",
  "content": "import sqlite3
from flask import g, current_app

DATABASE_PATH = "fitpulse.db"


def get_db():
    if "db" not in g:
        g.db = sqlite3.connect(
            current_app.config.get("DATABASE", DATABASE_PATH),
            detect_types=sqlite3.PARSE_DECLTYPES
        )
        g.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        g.db.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")
    return g.db


def close_db(e=None):
    db = g.pop("db", None)
    if db is not None:
        db.close()


def init_db():
    db = get_db()
    cursor = db.cursor()

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exercises (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT NOT NULL,
        target_muscle TEXT NOT NULL,
        equipment TEXT
    );
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workout_sessions (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        completed_at TEXT,
        notes TEXT,
        total_volume_kg REAL DEFAULT 0.0
    );
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workout_sets (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        exercise_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        set_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
        reps INTEGER NOT NULL,
        weight_kg REAL NOT NULL,
        rpe REAL,
        is_pr INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        FOREIGN KEY (exercise_id) REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    );
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workout_sets_session_id
    ON workout_sets(session_id);
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workout_sets_exercise_id
    ON workout_sets(exercise_id);
    """)

    # Triggers to keep total_volume_kg updated dynamically
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_set_insert_update_vol
    AFTER INSERT ON workout_sets
    BEGIN
        UPDATE workout_sessions
        SET total_volume_kg = (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reps * weight_kg), 0.0)
            FROM workout_sets
            WHERE session_id = NEW.session_id
        )
        WHERE id = NEW.session_id;
    END;
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_set_update_update_vol
    AFTER UPDATE ON workout_sets
    BEGIN
        UPDATE workout_sessions
        SET total_volume_kg = (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reps * weight_kg), 0.0)
            FROM workout_sets
            WHERE session_id = NEW.session_id
        )
        WHERE id = NEW.session_id;
        UPDATE workout_sessions
        SET total_volume_kg = (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reps * weight_kg), 0.0)
            FROM workout_sets
            WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id
        )
        WHERE id = OLD.session_id;
    END;
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_set_delete_update_vol
    AFTER DELETE ON workout_sets
    BEGIN
        UPDATE workout_sessions
        SET total_volume_kg = (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reps * weight_kg), 0.0)
            FROM workout_sets
            WHERE session_id = OLD.session_id
        )
        WHERE id = OLD.session_id;
    END;
    """)

    db.commit()


def init_app(app):
    app.teardown_appcontext(close_db)
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
"
